status: frozen before any comparison measurement of the f6885a9 candidate
decision: Publication requires at least four measured aspects, each a win or a tie, and no loss.

rule.unit: per run, the ratio Binit / competitor of the stated statistic
rule.interval: 95% percentile interval from a paired block bootstrap: blocks are the measured pairs, resampled with replacement, the same block indices for both subjects
run_verdict: win: interval upper bound below win_upper
loss: interval lower bound above loss_lower, and the difference interval lies wholly above the aspect's absolute_tie_ms
tie: interval upper bound at most tie_upper, or the absolute difference interval lies wholly within plus or minus absolute_tie_ms
inconclusive: anything else, and any ratio interval wider than max_interval_width unless the absolute rule decides a tie
rule.comparison_verdict: both runs agree; a win and a tie give a tie; any other mix is inconclusive
rule.aspect_verdict: any losing comparison loses the aspect; all wins win it; wins and ties tie it; otherwise inconclusive
